allow: PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach \($p in \($c.OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique\)\) { $proc = Get-Process -Id $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($proc\) { "killing PID $p \($\($proc.ProcessName\)\)"; Stop-Process -Id $p -Force } })
